limitations: Desktop Chrome checks and a screenshot were added. Mobile, screen reader and video checks were not performed.
Cost and token results are simulations with user-entered prices and fixed per-attempt token counts, not measured agent performance.
All steps always run and use one shared price set; branching, early termination and growing conversation context are not modeled.
Cache share is applied to reusable context on all attempts, including the first; actual cache eligibility and provider billing may differ.
Tool fees, media generation, unentered reasoning tokens, rate limits, taxes and failed-request billing exceptions are excluded.
No deployment, public repository, public URL or promotional post exists from this build.
